immigration.headline: Naturalized U.S. Citizen Indicted for Lying to Obtain U.S. Citizenship After Committing Felonies
immigration.body: A naturalized U.S. citizen made his initial appearance in court Sept. 2 for allegedly lying about his prior criminal acts to obtain U.S. citizenship. The U.S. Attorney's Office for the District of Nevada announced the charges.

immigration.headline: Illegal Alien Indicted in Marriage-Related Immigration Fraud
immigration.body: U.S. Citizenship and Immigration Services played a critical role in the investigation that led to the indictment of Miguel Angel Olivera‑Borda, 38, a Peruvian alien illegally present in the United States, after federal prosecutors presented evidence to a grand jury.

immigration.headline: Aunt and U.S. Airman Nephew Arrested in Immigration Fraud Scheme
immigration.body: Defendants allegedly lied about their relationship to obtain immigration benefits

immigration.headline: DHS Proposes Additional H-1B Fee
immigration.body: The Department of Homeland Security (DHS) is proposing to establish a $103,265 fee for all H-1B cap-subject petitions, including those eligible for the advanced degree exemption.

immigration.headline: Chinese Alien Charged with Voter Fraud in Massachusetts
immigration.body: A Chinese alien residing in Andover, Mass., was arrested for submitting a fraudulent voter registration and ballot in the 2024 presidential election using the name of another Chinese alien.
